utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Uli, what's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm not sure yet, Leo. Just trying to get by.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, do we need any tools or materials?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Are we sure we have enough supplies organized for the repair drive? I'm a bit worried about the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What exactly do we have organized? I'd like to see the list before I'm sure.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I was hoping you had the list—I haven't seen a final version myself.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, hey Oren. What's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A repair drive? Hmm, I think I heard something about that... Wait, is that the thing where we fix up old bikes?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, bikes? I thought it was for lawnmowers or something.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I heard there's a repair drive this weekend, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I think so! I saw a flyer at the grocery store about it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, so it's happening Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem! I've got my toolbox ready. Let's start by checking what broken items folks have brought in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it. Let's see what we've got here.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Quinn. I heard we're planning a repair drive. Do we have a schedule yet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not yet, but I'm planning to ask around. I'll let you know as soon as I hear something!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, I appreciate that. Just make sure to let me know once you've got a date set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What's the issue with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, the repair drive? I've been meaning to check it out. What seems to be the problem?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I noticed my brake pads are worn thin. Can you take a look?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hey Jules, have you seen the repair drive around? I need to ask about the fence.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I think I saw them near the old oak tree earlier. Need me to help you look?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa! Are you getting ready for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I'm gathering the supplies now! Do you need a sign-up sheet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be great! I can help coordinate the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Bo, do we have everything we need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Uh, I think so? I just grabbed whatever was on the list. Did I miss something?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Let me double-check the list against what you've got.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rey, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No, I haven't. What's it all about?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's a community event where folks bring broken items and volunteers fix them for free. I think it's at the community center from 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Faye, I heard you mentioned something about the repair drive? I want to make sure I understand what's needed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh hi Hana! Yes, we're collecting broken electronics and small appliances to fix and donate. Can you help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, I can help spread the word. What specific items are you looking for, and where should people drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Ira, what's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, you haven't heard? There's a drive to fix up the old community center this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, this weekend? What time are people meeting up?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Jules, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I heard about it! I was thinking of bringing my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I'll be there too! So you're bringing the blender on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Sorry, I think I missed something—what's going on?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, there's a community repair drive happening at the community center. We're fixing up old appliances and electronics.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh, I hadn't heard about that. Who's organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What kind of repairs are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, I've got a bunch of tools—maybe we could start with fixing that leaky faucet at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like a good place to start. I can help hold things or grab supplies if you need.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal, it's great that you're interested in the repair drive! What can I do to help you get started?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm wondering if you have a list of items that need repair and their current locations? That would help me plan the best route.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I've got a detailed list right here. Let me pull it up for you—it includes each item, the owner's name, and their address.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Do we have a plan for getting all the tools to the site by Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! I can rally a few neighbors with trucks to help haul everything over on Friday evening.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds good, but do we have a specific meeting point and time so everyone's on the same page?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? What exactly is that supposed to be?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It's a portable device with tools and spare parts for fixing common household issues.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: And how often does this thing actually come in handy, huh?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What's the schedule for the repair drive? I like to have things planned out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, you know me – I'll probably show up fashionably late. What time works best for everyone else?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I think 9 AM sharp would be best. That way we can get everything done before the heat sets in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hi! What's this repair drive I've been hearing about?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's a community effort to fix broken items around the neighborhood — I've been collecting spare parts and tools for it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds useful! Where can I drop off any broken things I have?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Mara, I'm glad you brought up the repair drive. What do we need to do again?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We need to gather broken items from the neighborhood and meet at the community center Saturday morning to fix them together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, right—broken items, Saturday morning. I'll start digging through my garage; I think I've got a toaster and a wobbly chair somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, I was thinking about the repair drive—how can we fit it around the school pickup times?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let's plan it for after 3 PM. What times work for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: After 3 PM works for me—I'm free most days from 3:15 onward.
